purpose.zh: 试试指尖贴墙时，掌根能抬多高、稳不稳
purpose.en: Tests how high and how steadily you can lift the heel of your hand with your fingertips on the wall.

text.zh: 指尖贴墙不动，慢慢把掌根抬起来
text.en: Fingertips stay on the wall, slowly lift the heel of your hand

text.zh: 面朝墙站稳，手臂放松，肩膀别耸。
text.en: Stand facing the wall, arm relaxed, shoulders down.

text.zh: 抬到还能稳住的最高点，停 3 秒再放回去。
text.en: Lift as high as you can hold steady, pause 3 seconds, then lower.

commonErrors.zh: 指尖在墙上滑或离开墙
commonErrors.en: Fingertips sliding or leaving the wall.

commonErrors.zh: 身子往前倒，代替手腕使劲
commonErrors.en: Leaning in instead of using your wrist.

cautions.zh: 手腕或手指疼就抬低点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your wrist or fingers hurt, don't lift as high. Stop if it still hurts.

changes: 动画 8 秒 1 次「抬起-停约 3.8 s-放回」在重复，剂量从 1 组 3 秒保持改为 1 组×5 次/侧（rep_hold）
